TZ.name: Stamp duty on conveyances on sale (immovable property)
TZ.statute: Stamp Duty Act Cap. 189 R.E. 2023, Schedule item 22 (a)-(b); Finance Acts 2024 and 2025 do not amend Cap. 189 (the Finance Act 2026 does, from 1 July 2026)
TZ.doc: Schedule item 22: conveyance not exceeding TShs 20 000 nil; above, 0,5 % for the first TShs 100 000 and 1 % of the value in excess of TShs 100 000.
unsupported: conveyance of agricultural land TShs 500 (item 22 (c)) and exemptions (Administrator General, EPZ, special purpose vehicles)
reduction by the duty paid on a stamped agreement for sale

TZ.name: Stamp duty on transfers of shares (unlisted)
TZ.statute: Stamp Duty Act Cap. 189 R.E. 2023, Schedule item 61 (a); not amended by the Finance Acts 2024-2025
TZ.doc: Schedule item 61 (a): transfer of shares in an incorporated company, 1 % of the value of the shares approved by the Board.
unsupported: listed shares traded on the stock exchange (exemptions outside item 61 not read)

UG.name: Stamp duty on transfers (land, buildings, unlisted shares)
UG.statute: Stamp Duty Act 2014, Schedule 2 item 63 (a) (ULII consolidation eng@2023-12-31; amendments after 2023 not checked)
UG.doc: Schedule 2 item 63: transfer, 1,5 % of the total value; (b) transfers of listed shares arising from trading on the stock exchange 0,5 %.
unsupported: exempted transfers (item 63 (c)-(d): special purpose vehicles, Islamic finance) and Nil items for licensed investors

UG.name: Stamp duty on transfers of listed shares traded on the stock exchange
UG.statute: Stamp Duty Act 2014, Schedule 2 item 63 (b) (ULII eng@2023-12-31)

GH.name: Stamp duty on conveyances or transfers on sale (rate of the value band on the whole consideration)
GH.statute: Stamp Duty Act 2005 (Act 689) Schedule 1, 'Conveyance or transfer on sale of a property'; amounts printed in old cedis, converted at 10 000 old cedis = GH₵ 1 (Currency Redenomination Act 2007, Act 724); later amendments not checked
GH.doc: Schedule 1: consideration not exceeding ¢100 000 000 (GH₵ 10 000) 0,25 %; above that and not exceeding ¢500 000 000 (GH₵ 50 000) 0,5 %; above ¢500 000 000 1 %; the band's rate applies to the whole consideration.
unsupported: the redenomination conversion of the printed thresholds is applied by the builder (flagged)
voluntary dispositions at the same rates on the value; other transfers 1 %
